description: This file defines the NamedRange class, which extends the DefinedName class to manage named ranges within spreadsheets, including creating named ranges, retrieving and setting their ranges, and extracting cell references within ranges.

classes.name: NamedRange
classes.description: A class representing a named range in a spreadsheet, with methods to manipulate and retrieve range information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new NamedRange object, requiring a name and optionally a worksheet or scope.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns the string value of the named range.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the range value for the named range.

methods.name: getCellsInRange
methods.description: Returns all cell references within the current range as an array.
